# Captured look output from tbaMUD — fixtures for M6 testing

## Simple room with exits

Market Square
You stand in a bustling marketplace with merchants hawking their wares. The smell of
fresh bread and exotic spices fills the air. Colorful banners flutter above vendor stalls.
[ Exits: north south east west ]

## Room with NPC and async spam (mob arrival during look)

Temple
A sacred temple with high vaulted ceilings. Sunlight streams through stained glass windows,
casting colored light across the marble floor.
A skeletal warrior arrives from the north.
[ Exits: north south ]

## Forest room with limited exits

Dark Forest Path
You walk through a dense forest where sunlight barely penetrates. Ancient oaks tower above,
their branches intertwined. The ground is carpeted with moss and fallen leaves.
[ Exits: north south ]

## Room with one-way exit indication

Tower Top
You stand atop a tall tower overlooking the land. Wind whips around you fiercely.
Below, the world spreads out in all directions.
[ Exits: down ]

## Alley with many exits

Alley Intersection
A crossroads of several alleys. Shops line the streets, and the alley extends in
multiple directions from here.
[ Exits: north south east west northeast northwest southeast southwest ]

## Same-named room in different location (tbaMUD variety)

Dark Alley
You stand in a narrow alley shrouded in shadow. The walls are close, and suspicious
figures linger in the darkness.
[ Exits: north east ]

## Longer description (testing truncation)

Palace Grand Hall
You stand in an immense hall with towering marble columns that reach toward a ceiling
so high it seems to touch the sky. Intricate mosaics cover the floor depicting scenes
of ancient battles and glory. A massive throne dominates the chamber, carved from a
single block of black stone and studded with gems. Tapestries of silk and gold hang
from the walls, their colors still vivid despite their obvious age. Servants in fine
livery move quietly about their duties. The air smells of incense and expensive perfume.
This is clearly the seat of power for the realm.
[ Exits: north south east west up ]
